title: Brussels · Ardennes Semois Sweep
slogan: A 317 km loop out of Dinant river
story: River bends, forest roads and a proper Belgian escape. A 317 km loop that starts and ends near Dinant, about 5 h 28 of riding. It goes by way of Bouillon castle bend, Semois valley roads and Namur. Back roads rather than main roads, where the map allows.

title: Brussels · Eifel and High Fens Day
slogan: Moorland, border roads and small-town stops.
story: Moorland, border roads and small-town stops. A 321 km loop that starts and ends near Spa, about 5 h 32 of riding. On the way it passes High Fens roads, Monschau old town and Eupen  roads. It crosses from Belgium into Germany - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. Back roads rather than main roads, where the map allows.
